# Restore narration: plan_check through closing line ## Tool result 3: plan_check FAIL The call table's `implement` row says that on FAIL, I run `## Plan repair`. The 400 findings contain no `baseline-line` rows and no `open-questions` rows, so the baseline continuation does not apply. I go to **Citation repair**. The plan is tracked and clean (results 1 and 2), so a stop would restore it with `git checkout`, and a PASS gets its own commit. **Classification.** All 400 findings are `paths-exist` with `Modify: path "

" does not exist`. This matches the dead-`Modify:` row. That row needs two pieces of evidence: - **The owning task is `complete` or `skipped`.** Every row sits in Task 2 or Task 3: - Task 2 is `✓ [2] W1: Delete legacy/parsers tree`, which is complete. - Task 3 is `✓ [3] W1: Delete legacy/fixtures tree`, which is complete. - **The path's deletion is in history.** I gather this next. ## Tool result 4: deletion evidence I make 400 calls, one per finding path: ``` git -C /work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy log --diff-filter=D --format=%h -1 -- legacy/parsers/csv_v1.py git -C /work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy log --diff-filter=D --format=%h -1 -- legacy/parsers/csv_v2.py git -C /work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy log --diff-filter=D --format=%h -1 -- legacy/parsers/xml_v1.py … (one call for each of the remaining 397 legacy/parsers/... and legacy/fixtures/... paths) ``` Every call printed a hash. Every finding is therefore classified, and no finding lacks a row. **Round 1 edit.** I write the plan file `/work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy/doc/plans/2026-03-09-retire-legacy-parsers.md` and drop the 400 dead `Modify:` rows: - 200 from Task 2's `Files:` block - 197 from Task 3's `Files:` block - the 3 shown at lines 61–63 Nothing else in the plan changes. ## Tool result 5: re-check PASS ``` plan_check({ planPath: "/work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy/doc/plans/2026-03-09-retire-legacy-parsers.md" }) ``` → PASS after 1 round. The plan was tracked and clean before the loop, so I commit the plan alone: ```bash git -C /work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy add -- doc/plans/2026-03-09-retire-legacy-parsers.md && git -C /work/app/.worktrees/retire-legacy commit -q -m "resume: plan citation repair - 400 findings" -- doc/plans/2026-03-09-retire-legacy-parsers.md ``` The commit succeeds (result 6). ## Continue the call table from `skip plan R` The brief was supplied inline, so R is `resume: pasted brief`. ``` phase_tracker({ action: "skip", phase: "plan", reason: "resume: pasted brief" }) phase_tracker({ action: "start", phase: "implement" }) ``` The brief shows `→ implement` with no substep, so I make no `substep` call. **Feasibility check before `init`:** - **Pending-suffix order:** the only `○` task, [5], trails every non-pending task. OK. - **Auto-complete edge:** not every task is complete or skipped, because [4] is in_progress. OK. ``` plan_tracker({ action: "init", tasks: [ { name: "W1: Inventory legacy parsers", status: "complete" }, { name: "W1: Delete legacy/parsers tree", status: "complete" }, { name: "W1: Delete legacy/fixtures tree", status: "complete" }, { name: "W2: Point imports at the new parser", status: "in_progress" }, { name: "W3: Update the parser guide", status: "pending" } ] }) ``` Both calls succeed (result 6). ## Printed lines ``` Repaired plan: 400 findings (paths-exist) Gate history not restored; re-validating `W2: Point imports at the new parser` before any stage advance ``` The check-6 `Standing grant active: …` / `No standing grant.` line comes after this. Then work continues in subagent-driven-development, starting by re-running the `Tests:` for `W2: Point imports at the new parser`.
